caption:
All those laps add up, especially through your lats and shoulders 🏊

Freestyle loads the lats, chest and back of the shoulder thousands of times a week. Many swimmers find remedial massage helps those areas feel looser between sessions.

Keep expectations realistic: massage complements strength work and good technique rather than replacing them. Go lighter before a hard set, deeper after a big week. Between visits, foam roll your lats for a minute each side and open your chest in a doorway.

Pain that catches mid-stroke or wakes you at night is worth a physio check first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio work alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
